answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in umber, expire in tide, and raven lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 147 aliases therefore needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1016 identities would post 3073 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
